text: Transportation Services recommends that the portion of the public lane at rear of 2112 and 2114 Yonge Street be permanently closed. The portion of the public lane abutting 2114 Yonge Street and at the rear of 2112 Yonge Street will be incorporated into the site for future development of the property.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the permanent closure of the portion of the public lane at the rear of 2112 and 2114 Yonge Street, shown as Part 1 on Sketch No. PS-2008-121 (the "Lane"), attached to the report (March 14, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District. 2. City Council enact a by-law substantially in the form of the draft by-law attached as Appendix A to the report (March 14, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
